I do not know what to do with myself. I have hated you so much for so long, and now that you are gone I fear I may go insane. 

The Great Serpent taking you before I could kill you myself is a slap in the face that I will never recover from. 

I curse your spirit, and will never forgive you for what you have done to me. I hope that wherever you are, it is painful.
